These findings supported the diagnosis of PP.

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 4 panels (A, B, C, D). A: Panel A is H&E histology of the patient's biopsy explicitly captioned as acute suppurative panniculitis with lobular predominance, a classic histologic presentation of pancreatic panniculitis. B: Higher-power H&E of the same biopsy showing the neutrophil-rich inflammatory infiltrate within fat, supporting pancreatic panniculitis histology as captioned. C: Ghost cells (anucleate necrotic adipocytes) with steatonecrosis are the hallmark, pathognomonic histologic feature of pancreatic panniculitis; caption explicitly states this. D: von Kossa stain demonstrating calcification within steatonecrotic fat corresponds to saponification/calcified fat necrosis, a recognized histologic finding of pancreatic panniculitis per the caption and in-text description of incipient calcification.
